$schema: Single source of truth for the warehouse model. Every value here is an INDEPENDENT input — nothing here is a calculated output. FreeCAD (freecad/create_model.py), the analytical model (web/src/calculations.js) and the web UI all read this same file so they can never disagree about what a parameter means or what range it's allowed to take.

warehouse_length.description: Overall building length, measured along the direction the rack aisles run (the direction a forklift travels furthest).

warehouse_width.description: Overall building width, perpendicular to the aisles — this is what limits how many rack rows fit side by side.

clear_height.description: Clear height under the roof structure. Must exceed rack height plus clearance for sprinklers/lighting; the model warns if racks don't fit.

wall_thickness.description: Perimeter wall thickness (tilt-up concrete panel range). Affects only the building envelope, not usable floor area meaningfully at this scale.

rack_height.description: Top-beam height of the storage rack. Taller racks pack more levels into the same footprint, but need taller (costlier) lift trucks and a taller building.

rack_depth.description: Single-deep pallet rack depth (front to back). Two rows are placed back-to-back between aisles.

bay_width.description: Width of one rack bay (the repeating upright-to-upright frame module) — this is how many meters of aisle one storage position 'costs' along the row.

levels_per_rack.description: Number of storage levels stacked in the rack, floor level included.

positions_per_level_per_bay.description: Pallet positions across one bay's width at one level (1 = single pallet per bay, 2 = double-deep or two standard pallets side by side).

aisle_width.description: Clear aisle width between two facing rack rows — set by the turning radius of the lift truck fleet. Narrower aisles fit more rack rows but restrict equipment choice.

num_receiving_docks.description: Number of inbound truck dock doors.

num_shipping_docks.description: Number of outbound truck dock doors.

dock_bay_width.description: Width allotted per dock door along the dock wall, trailer-width driven.

cross_aisle_width.description: Clear staging zone at each end of the racking, between the dock doors and the first rack row — reserved for staging and cross-traffic, not used for storage.

current_inventory_pallets.description: Pallets currently in storage — set independently of physical capacity, on purpose: this is what lets you see utilization exceed 100% when you shrink capacity without shrinking demand.

daily_throughput_pallets.description: Pallets moved in + out per day (inbound plus outbound, combined) — drives dock loading and total travel distance.

dock_handling_rate.description: Sustained pallets processed per hour per active dock door, loading/unloading + paperwork included.

operating_hours_per_day.description: Hours per day the docks and floor are actively operating (e.g. two shifts = 16h).

forklift_speed.description: Loaded travel speed used for the travel-time estimate (reach trucks in narrow aisles run slower than counterbalance trucks in open floor).

forklift_cycle_overhead.description: Fixed time per trip that isn't travel — picking/placing the pallet, lift/lower at height, aisle turn.

cost_per_rack_position.description: Installed cost per storage position (racking, hardware, install) — illustrative, not a quotation.

cost_per_sqm_building.description: Shell building cost per square metre of footprint — illustrative, scales with clear height beyond this base rate is not modeled.

cost_per_dock.description: Installed cost per dock door (leveler, seal, door, door control) — illustrative.
